#1 Loading Libraries
```{r include=FALSE}
# qdap requires 64-bit version of Java

library(warbleR)
library(Rraven)
library(tidyverse)
library(qdap)
library(chron)
library(hms)
library(mapview)
library(data.table)
library(geodist)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(igraph)
# Show 100 columns in preview
rstudioapi::writeRStudioPreference("data_viewer_max_columns", 100L)
```

#2 Loading Data
```{r}
rvn.dat <- imp_raven(all.data = TRUE, path = "./raven_data", warbler.format = TRUE)
```

#3 Cleaning
```{r}
# Editing out unnecessary columns
# Fixing errors: sound.file entry incorrect for 20220509_LbLpY_ST1.wav and 20220519_KLgK_KV_1.WAV
rvn.dat <- rvn.dat %>% 
  subset(select = -c(View,Channel,ST2, ST3, Bird, Rec_Date)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.character, stringr::str_replace_all, pattern = "LbLpY_ST1.wav", replacement = "20220509_LbLpY_KV_1.wav") %>%
  dplyr::mutate_if(is.character, stringr::str_replace_all, pattern = "20220519__KLgK_KV_1.WAV", replacement = "20220519_KLgK_KV_1.WAV") 

# splitting sound.files into multiple columns
# Editing out unnecessary columns
rvn.dat.clean <- rvn.dat %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(sound.files,"_",names = c("date","ID","recordist","junk")) %>%
  subset(select = -c(junk, Recordist)) 

#add sound.files back because we need it to make selection tables later
rvn.dat.clean$sound.files <- rvn.dat$sound.files

# replace UBM(Dove) w name, but first have to get rid of parentheses
rvn.dat.clean$ID <-  genX(rvn.dat.clean$ID, " (", ")")

# Replace Dove w WLpTb
# Clean up data_class column
rvn.dat.clean <-  rvn.dat.clean %>%
  mutate(across('ID', str_replace, 'UBM', 'WLpTb')) %>%
  mutate(across('Data_Class', str_replace, 'End', 'end')) %>%
  mutate(across('Data_Class', str_replace, 'comment.', 'comment')) %>%
  mutate(across('Data_Class', str_replace, 'comments', 'comment'))

#Selecting birds (to exclude OKO)
birds_to_include <- c('KLgK', 'KWY', 'LbLpY', 'LpRbTb', 'DgTbO', 'LbOW', 'RRO', 'TbTbLg', 'YKY', 'RbDgY', 'KRDg', 'OPR','TbWY', 'WLpTb')

rvn.dat.clean <- rvn.dat.clean %>%
  filter(ID %in% birds_to_include)

# cleaning up ST1 column
rvn.dat.clean <- rvn.dat.clean %>%
  mutate(across('ST1', str_replace, 'u', 'U'))
  
# separating songs and non-songs into two data frames
rvn.dat.clean.songs <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, Data_Class == "song")
rvn.dat.clean.not.songs <- filter (rvn.dat.clean, Data_Class != "song")

# Old problem with NAs in YKY (see annotation in Basic_9.0 and earlier)

# Cleaning songs dataframe
# Here we correct for ST errors. More annotation in Basic_9.0 and earlier.
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$date == '20220518' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$ID == 'LbOW' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$selec == 209] <- "6"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$date == '20220513' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$ID == 'YKY' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$selec == 122] <- "20"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == 'Not in repertoire, skeptical'] <- "ID"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == 'note'] <- "u"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == '5*'] <- "5"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == '6*'] <- "6"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == 'Skeptical ID'] <- "ID"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == 'Unscoreable'] <- "U"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == 'Not in rep, skeptical'] <- "ID"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1 == 'u'] <- "U"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$date == '20220510' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$ID == 'KLgK' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$selec == 43] <- "4"
rvn.dat.clean.songs$ST1[rvn.dat.clean.songs$date == '20220513' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$ID == 'RRO' & rvn.dat.clean.songs$selec == 2] <- "17"

#rejoining songs and not songs
rvn.dat.clean <- rbind(rvn.dat.clean.songs,rvn.dat.clean.not.songs)

#Fixing off bird
rvn.dat.clean$Data_Class[rvn.dat.clean$Data_Class == 'off bird'] <- "off"

# Omit "ID" songs
rvn.dat.clean <- rvn.dat.clean %>%
 filter(ST1 != ID | is.na(ST1))


```

#4 time "off bird" 1 (makes rows of data_class "begin_off" "end_off" and "off_bird_block")
```{r}
# Goal: Make off blocks

# before join: rvn.dat.clean = 12471 obs, 15 var; off_bird_join = 109 obs, 5 var (none unique)
# Import off_bird_join csv
off_bird_join <- read.csv("off_bird/off_bird_join_4.csv")

#convert dates to numeric 
off_bird_join$date <- as.numeric(off_bird_join$date)
rvn.dat.clean$date <- as.numeric(rvn.dat.clean$date)

#full joining
rvn.dat.clean <- full_join(rvn.dat.clean,off_bird_join)

#that seemed to work! I now have entries under Data_Class = off_bird_block that describe the start and end time of the off blocks. Set max end to 5000 bc that's later than any real values (max ~ 4850)

just_on_off <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, Data_Class == "off_bird_block")
just_on_off

# Making dfs for "begin_off" and "end_off" times and joining them to the main dataset
# Setting up times for beginning of off blocks
off_bird_starts <- off_bird_join %>% select(date,ID,start,Data_Class) 
off_bird_starts <- off_bird_starts %>% mutate(Data_Class = str_replace(Data_Class, "off_bird_block", "begin_off"))
rvn.dat.clean <- full_join(rvn.dat.clean,off_bird_starts)

# Setting up times for end of off blocks
off_bird_ends <- off_bird_join %>% select(date,ID,start = end,Data_Class) 
off_bird_ends <- off_bird_ends %>% mutate(Data_Class = str_replace(Data_Class, "off_bird_block", "end_off"))
rvn.dat.clean <- full_join(rvn.dat.clean,off_bird_ends)

# Decided to make another chunk to make individual "off" columns. I put it after the time chunk so that "start" times are already converted to "time relative to sunrise"

unique(rvn.dat.clean$Data_Class)
```
#5 Time
```{r}
# Goal: Add columns for click time (done), real time (done), sunrise time (done), time rel sunrise (done)

#A look-up table using case_match to add clock time of click  
rvn.dat.clean$click_clock <- case_match  (
      rvn.dat.clean$date,
      20220509	~ "05:14:00",
      20220510	~ "05:10:10",
      20220511 ~	"05:08:45",
      20220512	~ "05:09:30",
      20220513	~ "05:11:40",
      20220514	~ "05:09:00",
      20220516	~ "05:09:00",
      20220517	~ "05:08:20",
      20220518	~ "04:59:30",
      20220519	~ "05:01:10",
      20220520	~ "05:01:20",
      20220521	~ "05:09:00",
      20220523	~ "05:11:30",
      20220524	~ "05:07:00"
      )

#making a DF with just click rows and checking recording times at moment of click 
just_clicks <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, Data_Class == "click")

# just_clicks
click_rec <- select(just_clicks,"date","ID","start","end")
click_rec

#used this to look at click durations (time bt start and end of click). Where these varied within a day, I checked the orig recording and fixed the cursor placement on the click waveform, then saved and copied to "raven_data"
click_rec_2 <- mutate(click_rec,click_dur = end - start)
click_rec_2

#reduced the variable set and renamed column to "click_rec" which is the recording time of the first click
click_rec_3 <- select(click_rec_2, "date","ID", "start")
click_rec_4 <- rename(click_rec_3, "click_rec" = "start")

#left joining to add click_rec column to main dataset
rvn.dat.clean <- left_join(rvn.dat.clean,click_rec_4)

#turn start and click into hms class
rvn.dat.clean$start_hms <- as_hms(rvn.dat.clean$start)

rvn.dat.clean$click_clock_hms <- as_hms(rvn.dat.clean$click_clock)

rvn.dat.clean$click_rec_hms <- as_hms(rvn.dat.clean$click_rec)

#add start to click to arrive at time, then convert time to hms class. Note: changed variable "time" to "clock_time" for clarity in v7.2
rvn.dat.clean$clock_time <- rvn.dat.clean$click_clock_hms + rvn.dat.clean$start_hms - rvn.dat.clean$click_rec_hms

rvn.dat.clean$clock_time <- as_hms(rvn.dat.clean$clock_time)

# Sunrise times
# Tried some dedicated functions to get sunrise times, but none worked well, so I just looked it up on www.timeanddate.com

rvn.dat.clean$sunrise <- case_match  (
      rvn.dat.clean$date,
      20220509	~ "05:58:00",
      20220510	~ "05:57:30",
      20220511 ~	"05:57:00",
      20220512	~ "05:57:00",
      20220513	~ "05:56:30",
      20220514	~ "05:56:00",
      20220516	~ "05:55:30",
      20220517	~ "05:55:00",
      20220518	~ "05:55:00",
      20220519	~ "05:54:30",
      20220520	~ "05:54:00",
      20220521	~ "05:54:00",
      20220523	~ "05:53:30",
      20220524	~ "05:53:00"
      )

#change sunrise time to hms class
rvn.dat.clean$sunrise <- as_hms(rvn.dat.clean$sunrise)

#calculate time relative to sunrise
rvn.dat.clean$time_rel_sunrise <-  rvn.dat.clean$clock_time - rvn.dat.clean$sunrise 

```

#6 Time "off bird" 2 (makes and populates "M#_Off" columns)
```{r}
#Make dates numeric
rvn.dat.clean$date <- as.numeric(rvn.dat.clean$date)

# Split into neighbourhoods
# use %in% to "keep any of the following"
rvn.dat.clean.south <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, date %in% c(20220509, 20220510, 20220511, 20220512))
rvn.dat.clean.north <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, date %in% c(20220513, 20220514, 20220516, 20220517,20220518))
rvn.dat.clean.centre <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, date %in% c(20220519, 20220520, 20220521, 20220523,20220524))

# sort by date, time and group by date
rvn.dat.clean.south <- rvn.dat.clean.south %>% arrange(date,start) %>% group_by(date)

# if_else mutate to make and populate M#_Off columns based on begin_off and end_off values in Data_Class. "1" means that bird is not being observed at that time; 0 and NA mean that it is. Below I convert NA's to 0's. 
rvn.dat.clean.south <- rvn.dat.clean.south %>% mutate(M1_Off = if_else(ID == "LbLpY" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "LbLpY" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M1_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.south <- rvn.dat.clean.south %>% mutate(M2_Off = if_else(ID == "KWY" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "KWY" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M2_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.south <- rvn.dat.clean.south %>% mutate(M3_Off = if_else(ID == "KLgK" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "KLgK" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M3_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.south <- rvn.dat.clean.south %>% mutate(M4_Off = if_else(ID == "LpRbTb" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "LpRbTb" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M4_Off)

rvn.dat.clean.north <- rvn.dat.clean.north %>% mutate(M1_Off = if_else(ID == "LbOW" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "LbOW" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M1_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.north <- rvn.dat.clean.north %>% mutate(M2_Off = if_else(ID == "RbDgY" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "RbDgY" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M2_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.north <- rvn.dat.clean.north %>% mutate(M3_Off = if_else(ID == "YKY" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "YKY" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M3_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.north <- rvn.dat.clean.north %>% mutate(M4_Off = if_else(ID == "TbTbLg" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "TbTbLg" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M4_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.north <- rvn.dat.clean.north %>% mutate(M5_Off = if_else(ID == "DgTbO" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "DgTbO" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M5_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.north <- rvn.dat.clean.north %>% mutate(M6_Off = if_else(ID == "RRO" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "RRO" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M6_Off)

rvn.dat.clean.centre <- rvn.dat.clean.centre %>% mutate(M1_Off = if_else(ID == "TbWY" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "TbWY" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M1_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.centre <- rvn.dat.clean.centre %>% mutate(M2_Off = if_else(ID == "KRDg" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "KRDg" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M2_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.centre <- rvn.dat.clean.centre %>% mutate(M3_Off = if_else(ID == "OPR" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "OPR" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M3_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.centre <- rvn.dat.clean.centre %>% mutate(M4_Off = if_else(ID == "WLpTb" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "WLpTb" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M4_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.centre <- rvn.dat.clean.centre %>% mutate(M5_Off = if_else(ID == "KLgK" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "KLgK" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M5_Off)
rvn.dat.clean.centre <- rvn.dat.clean.centre %>% mutate(M6_Off = if_else(ID == "DgTbO" & Data_Class == "end_off", 0, 
    if_else(ID == "DgTbO" & Data_Class == "begin_off", 1,NA)))%>%
    fill(M6_Off)

ungroup(rvn.dat.clean.south)
ungroup(rvn.dat.clean.north)
ungroup(rvn.dat.clean.centre)

rvn.dat.clean <- rbind(rvn.dat.clean.south,rvn.dat.clean.north,rvn.dat.clean.centre)

# replace NA's with 0's in M#_Off columns
rvn.dat.clean$M1_Off[is.na(rvn.dat.clean$M1_Off)] <- 0
rvn.dat.clean$M2_Off[is.na(rvn.dat.clean$M2_Off)] <- 0
rvn.dat.clean$M3_Off[is.na(rvn.dat.clean$M3_Off)] <- 0
rvn.dat.clean$M4_Off[is.na(rvn.dat.clean$M4_Off)] <- 0
rvn.dat.clean$M5_Off[is.na(rvn.dat.clean$M5_Off)] <- 0
rvn.dat.clean$M6_Off[is.na(rvn.dat.clean$M6_Off)] <- 0
```

```{r}
# Goal: columns of distance from each bird to other bird (using mutate)

#Make dates numeric
rvn.dat.clean$date <- as.numeric(rvn.dat.clean$date)

# Split into neighbourhoods, then rejoin
# use %in% to "keep any of the following" 
rvn.dat.clean.south <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, date %in% c(20220509, 20220510, 20220511, 20220512))

rvn.dat.clean.north <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, date %in% c(20220513, 20220514, 20220516, 20220517,20220518))

rvn.dat.clean.centre <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, date %in% c(20220519, 20220520, 20220521, 20220523,20220524))

# For each neighbourhood: Number males (done), sort by date then time (done), add columns of current location for each male, all IIDs, rbind to combine neighbourhoods and rename

# South neighbourhood
# 1. LbLpY, 2. KWY, 3. KLgK, 4. LpRbTb
# arrange by  date, time 
rvn.dat.clean.south <- rvn.dat.clean.south %>% 
  arrange(date, time_rel_sunrise)

#Set up Lat and Lon columns for each male. "Mutate" makes column and transfers appropriate lat / lon, "fill" fills down. group_by makes it start over for each date. 
rvn.dat.clean.south <- rvn.dat.clean.south %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  mutate(M1_Lat = if_else(ID == "LbLpY", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M1_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M1_Lon = if_else(ID == "LbLpY", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M1_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M2_Lat = if_else(ID == "KWY", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M2_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M2_Lon = if_else(ID == "KWY", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M2_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M3_Lat = if_else(ID == "KLgK", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M3_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M3_Lon = if_else(ID == "KLgK", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M3_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M4_Lat = if_else(ID == "LpRbTb", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M4_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M4_Lon = if_else(ID == "LpRbTb", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M4_Lon)

# North neighbourhood
# 1. LbOW, 2. RbDgY, 3. YKY, 4. TbTbLg 5.DgTbO 6.RRO 
# See explanation under South Neighbourhood

rvn.dat.clean.north <- rvn.dat.clean.north %>%
  arrange(date, time_rel_sunrise) %>%
  
  group_by(date) %>%
  mutate(M1_Lat = if_else(ID == "LbOW", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M1_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M1_Lon = if_else(ID == "LbOW", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M1_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M2_Lat = if_else(ID == "RbDgY", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M2_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M2_Lon = if_else(ID == "RbDgY", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M2_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M3_Lat = if_else(ID == "YKY", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M3_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M3_Lon = if_else(ID == "YKY", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M3_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M4_Lat = if_else(ID == "TbTbLg", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M4_Lat) %>%

# Centre neighbourhood
# 1. TbWY, 2. KRDg, 3. OPR, 4. WLpTb 5. KLgK 6. DgTbO

rvn.dat.clean.centre <- rvn.dat.clean.centre %>%
  arrange(date, time_rel_sunrise) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  
  mutate(M1_Lat = if_else(ID == "TbWY", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M1_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M1_Lon = if_else(ID == "TbWY", Lon, NA))  %>%

  mutate(M2_Lat = if_else(ID == "KRDg", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M2_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M2_Lon = if_else(ID == "KRDg", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M2_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M3_Lat = if_else(ID == "OPR", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M3_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M3_Lon = if_else(ID == "OPR", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M3_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M4_Lat = if_else(ID == "WLpTb", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M4_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M4_Lon = if_else(ID == "WLpTb", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M4_Lon)  %>%

  mutate(M5_Lat = if_else(ID == "KLgK", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M5_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M5_Lon = if_else(ID == "KLgK", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M5_Lon) %>%

  mutate(M6_Lat = if_else(ID == "DgTbO", Lat, NA))  %>%
  fill(M6_Lat) %>%
  mutate(M6_Lon = if_else(ID == "DgTbO", Lon, NA))  %>%
  fill(M6_Lon) 

# Also need to ungroup and merge. Not sure of best order of operations. Maybe 1. ungroup (done), 2 .merge (done), 3. IID columns

ungroup(rvn.dat.clean.south)
ungroup(rvn.dat.clean.north)
ungroup(rvn.dat.clean.centre)

rvn.dat.clean <- rbind(rvn.dat.clean.south,rvn.dat.clean.north,rvn.dat.clean.centre)

# IIDs
# First make data frames of each number-male's Lon / Lat
M1_LL <- data.frame(x = rvn.dat.clean$M1_Lon, y = rvn.dat.clean$M1_Lat)
M2_LL <- data.frame(x = rvn.dat.clean$M2_Lon, y = rvn.dat.clean$M2_Lat)
M3_LL <- data.frame(x = rvn.dat.clean$M3_Lon, y = rvn.dat.clean$M3_Lat)
M4_LL <- data.frame(x = rvn.dat.clean$M4_Lon, y = rvn.dat.clean$M4_Lat)
M5_LL <- data.frame(x = rvn.dat.clean$M5_Lon, y = rvn.dat.clean$M5_Lat)
M6_LL <- data.frame(x = rvn.dat.clean$M6_Lon, y = rvn.dat.clean$M6_Lat)

# Pairwise IID calculations with geodist. Paired means it compares the two dfs, sequential means it compares one to one, rather than generating a matrix
rvn.dat.clean$D_M1_M2 <- geodist (x = M1_LL, y = M2_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M1_M3 <- geodist (x = M1_LL, y = M3_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M1_M4 <- geodist (x = M1_LL, y = M4_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M1_M5 <- geodist (x = M1_LL, y = M5_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M1_M6 <- geodist (x = M1_LL, y = M6_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)

rvn.dat.clean$D_M2_M3 <- geodist (x = M2_LL, y = M3_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M2_M4 <- geodist (x = M2_LL, y = M4_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M2_M5 <- geodist (x = M2_LL, y = M5_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M2_M6 <- geodist (x = M2_LL, y = M6_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)

rvn.dat.clean$D_M3_M4 <- geodist (x = M3_LL, y = M4_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M3_M5 <- geodist (x = M3_LL, y = M5_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M3_M6 <- geodist (x = M3_LL, y = M6_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)

rvn.dat.clean$D_M4_M5 <- geodist (x = M4_LL, y = M5_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
rvn.dat.clean$D_M4_M6 <- geodist (x = M4_LL, y = M6_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)

rvn.dat.clean$D_M5_M6 <- geodist (x = M5_LL, y = M6_LL, paired = TRUE, sequential = TRUE)
```

#11 Matching descriptive stats and summary columns, based on USTs
```{r}
# total matches per song (counts all songs that were matched, even if one song matches three others)
# Variable called "number_of_matches"
columns_to_sum <- c ("M1_match", "M2_match", "M3_match", "M4_match", "M5_match", "M6_match")
rvn.dat.clean$number_of_matches <-  rowSums(rvn.dat.clean[columns_to_sum], na.rm = T)

# Songs that match other songs (counts songs that match at least one other song, max = 1)
# Variable called "does_it_match"
rvn.dat.clean$does_it_match <-  if_else(rvn.dat.clean$number_of_matches>0,1,0)

# total number of song matches (all days) based on number_of_matches
all_song_matches <- sum(rvn.dat.clean$number_of_matches, na.rm = T)
all_song_matches

# total number of matching songs (all days) based on does_it_match
all_matching_songs <- sum(rvn.dat.clean$does_it_match, na.rm = T)
all_matching_songs

#Match rate (proportion of songs that are matching songs) based on does_it_match
rvn.dat.clean.songs <- filter(rvn.dat.clean, Data_Class == "song")
match_rate <- all_matching_songs / NROW(rvn.dat.clean.songs$does_it_match)
match_rate
```

#14 define DC
```{r}
# make variables date, DateTime in POSIXct format, and Bird_Date
rvn.dat.clean.1 <- rvn.dat.clean %>%
    mutate(
    date = as.Date(as.character(date), format = "%Y%m%d"), 
    DateTime = as.POSIXct(paste(date, clock_time), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  # Add unique bird recording as a column
    Bird_Date = paste(ID, date, sep = "_")) 

# separating songs and non-songs into two data frames
rvn.dat.clean.1.songs <- filter(rvn.dat.clean.1, Data_Class == "song")
rvn.dat.clean.1.not.songs <- filter (rvn.dat.clean.1, Data_Class != "song")

# arrange rvn.dat.clean.1.songs by time within ID and date, add columns for Time_Diff and RepeatST, change name of df to DD
DD <- rvn.dat.clean.1.songs %>%
  arrange(Bird_Date, DateTime) %>% # Ensure rows are ordered by time within each group
   group_by(Bird_Date) %>%
 mutate(
    # Calculate time difference between consecutive rows
    Time_Diff = as.numeric(difftime(DateTime, lag(DateTime, default = first(DateTime)), units = "secs")), 
    # Check if Song.Type is the same as the previous row
    RepeatST = ifelse(is.na(UST) | is.na(lag(UST)), FALSE, UST == lag(UST)) #sometimes UST is NA, that makes the current and following row for repeat ST NA
  ) 


# Make list of unique bird_dates 
recordings <- unique(DD$Bird_Date)

# Parameters
T <- 1000  # Lag threshold in seconds
Tseq <- 2 # Consecutive occurrences of lag >= T required to initiate cutoff
R <- 7   # Number of consecutive TRUE values required in RepeatST
S <- 40   # Start (excludes the first S songs for DC consideration)

# adds a lag threshold cutoff to data frame
DD <- DD %>% 
  mutate(Time_Diff = as.numeric(Time_Diff),
         GreaterThanT = Time_Diff >= T)

DD$Repeat_ST_Run <- with(DD, {
  run_id <- cumsum(!RepeatST)  # Create groups that reset on FALSE
  sequence <- ave(RepeatST, run_id, FUN = function(x) ifelse(x, seq_along(x)-1, 0))
  sequence +1
})

#Add Long_Latency_Run column for cumulative latencies > T
DD$Long_Latency_Run <- with(DD, {
  run_id <- cumsum(!GreaterThanT)  # Create groups that reset on FALSE
  sequence <- ave(GreaterThanT, run_id, FUN = function(x) ifelse(x, seq_along(x)-1, 0))
  sequence
})
 
# columns that say whether a row meets the latency and repetition meet the threshold, a column that says whether it meets either threshold

DD <- DD %>%
  mutate(meets_lat_thresh = if_else(Long_Latency_Run >= Tseq ,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(meets_rep_thresh = if_else(Repeat_ST_Run >= R ,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(meets_either_thresh = if_else(row_number()<=S,0, if_else(meets_rep_thresh + meets_lat_thresh >= 1,1,0)))

  
# Column "Phase" shows DC or PDC


DD <- DD %>%
  group_by(Bird_Date) %>%
  mutate(
    Phase = {
      first_thresh_index <- which(meets_either_thresh == 1)
      if (length(first_thresh_index) == 0) {
        rep("DC", n())
      } else {
        switch_point <- min(first_thresh_index) - R +1
        if_else(row_number() < switch_point, "DC", "PDC")
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Column End_DC to mark end of DC
DD <- DD %>%
  group_by(Bird_Date) %>%
  mutate(
    End_DC = if_else(Phase == "PDC" & lag(Phase, default = "DC") == "DC", 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

###  ###

test_set <- DD %>%
  filter(Bird_Date == "RRO_2022-05-16")

all_bird_dates <- unique(DD$Bird_Date)

```

#15 visualize DC cutoffs
```{r, warning=FALSE}

# Get unique Bird_Date combinations
bird_date_combinations <- unique(DD$Bird_Date)

# Initialize a list to store plots
p <- list()

# Loop over each Bird_Date combination
for (i in seq_along(bird_date_combinations)) {
  # Subset data for the current Bird_Date
  subset <- DD %>% filter(Bird_Date == bird_date_combinations[i])
  
  # Identify DateTime values where End_DC == 1
  end_dc_times <- subset %>% filter(End_DC == 1) %>% pull(DateTime)
  
  # Create the plot
  p[[i]] <- ggplot(subset, aes(x = DateTime, y = Time_Diff)) +
    geom_line(size = 1, color = "black") +  # Single black line for Time_Diff
    geom_point(aes(color = as.factor(RepeatST)), size = 2) +  # Color points based on RepeatST
    labs(
      title = paste("Line Graph for Bird_Date", bird_date_combinations[i]),
      x = "Time of Observation",
      y = "Song Latency (seconds)",
      color = "RepeatST"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "blue", "FALSE" = "orange")) + # Custom colors for TRUE/FALSE
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    # Add vertical red dotted lines where End_DC == 1 (pounded out bc red lines aren't in the right places)
    geom_vline(
  data = subset %>% filter(End_DC == 1),
  aes(xintercept = as.numeric(DateTime)),
  linetype = "dotted",
  color = "red",
  size = 1
)
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("Figures/DC_Cutoff/", bird_date_combinations[i], ".jpeg"),
    plot = p[[i]],
    width = 400,
    height = 200,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 300
  )
}

```

```{r}
rvn.dat.clean.2 <- bind_rows(DD, rvn.dat.clean.1.not.songs)

rvn.dat.clean.2 <- rvn.dat.clean.2 %>%
  arrange(Bird_Date, DateTime)
```
